answer_2.quote: We use BARTScore to measure the probability of generating a sub-argument from its parent, and NLI-based non-contradiction probability to assess logical support. ... We also parsed all generated essays into Rhetorical Structure Theory (RST) trees. A higher number of arguments (EDUs) and more complex relationships result in deeper RST trees.
